summary: Your Pall Mall clinic has Google reviews and a calm, discreet positioning, but template code and conflicting details show on the page.

findings.problem: The cookie banner shows {title} three times and Manage {vendor_count} vendors. The newsletter form shows name twice and no visible email field.
findings.cost: Unfilled code at the first screen looks careless on a premium clinic.
findings.fix: A clean banner and working sign up form.

findings.problem: Session length is 15-30 minutes in one place, 30 in another and about 10 to 20 in the FAQ. Results appear within a few days in the FAQ and in 10-14 days in the summary.
findings.cost: Conflicting facts make patients doubt the information.

findings.problem: No booking form. Book Now repeats about six times to a separate page, WhatsApp is only in the footer, and no prices show.
findings.cost: Patients who want to book or check cost have to dig, and many leave.
findings.fix: A short form, a visible WhatsApp button and from prices.

findings.problem: No before and after photos. Typos include injections injections and a anti-wrinkle. The email is info@drgoziem.com, a different name from the brand.
findings.cost: Cosmetic patients choose on proof, and small errors weaken trust.
findings.fix: Captioned results, proofread copy and a brand email.

redesign: A booking form and WhatsApp button on every page, with from prices.
Captioned results and one clear, consistent treatment page.
